question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Serpentine
solution: The correct answer is **"Zigzag."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Serpentine"** means having a winding course, like a snake, zigzag. (साँप की तरह घुमावदार रास्ता होना) • **Example**: *He has just completed a three-mile long serpentine sculpture in a New Zealand estuary.* • **"Zigzag"** also means having a winding course, with sharp turns in alternating directions. (एक घुमावदार मार्ग, जिसमें वैकल्पिक दिशाओं में तीव्र मोड़ हैं) • **Example**: *Those roads were **zig zag**__.* • Both words are synonyms, but zigzag emphasizes the sharpness of the turns. • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Nascent"** means just beginning to exist or develop. (आरंभिक अवस्था, उदीयमान; विकासशील) • **"Prosthetic"** means relating to an artificial limb or body part. (किसी कृत्रिम अंग या शरीर के अंग से संबंधित) • **"Fiery"** means full of fire or energy, or relating to fire. (आग या ऊर्जा से भरा हुआ, या आग से संबंधित) 33:T94d, The correct answer is **"Among the 11 members of the team."**
